verdict.rationale: Solid's docs explicitly describe Resources for loading server data as reactive state, combined with SSR, streaming, progressive hydration, and Suspense/concurrent rendering—together enabling async data fetched during SSR to flow into interactive client components (solid-gh-3, solid-gh-4, solid-gh-11, solid-gh-13). One community post cautions that Suspense and SolidStart routing 'can be very slow with no workaround,' a real-world caveat on this pattern's performance (solid-comm-15). Missing for 10: a concrete first-party or hands-on code example demonstrating server component fetch -> client hydration, and independent benchmarking of this specific flow.
